research.searchCoverage: Algolia, Inc. is identified in its official legal notice as a Delaware corporation; the official October 7 2025 supply-chain report describes the Salesloft/Drift incident and limits accessed data to Algolia CRM/business records, with no claim of Algolia platform compromise. Targeted official-source incident/control search performed 2026-09-13; bounded coverage is not a breach-free claim.

breach.coverage: Algolia official October 7 2025 report describes Salesloft/Drift access to Algolia Salesforce CRM/business records, limited to common business contact and account/conversation data; it did not report Algolia platform compromise. Remediation invalidated tokens, removed Drift, severed connections, terminated Salesloft, and audited other Salesforce connections.

exception.authority: User waiver dated 2026-09-13 for historical non-China incidents
exception.incident: Salesloft/Drift third-party CRM access reported by Algolia on 2025-10-07
exception.remediation: Tokens invalidated; Drift removed; connections severed; Salesloft terminated; other Salesforce connections audited.
exception.residualRisk: Third-party CRM data exposure remains a historical residual risk; live authentication unverified.
exception.adoption: User waiver dated 2026-09-13 explicitly permits historical non-China incident adoption for these Algolia search and indexing operations.
exception.usefulness: List, search, get, and curated indexing operations provide useful account and index access while preserving provider JSON contracts.
